The woman was observing an arrest conducted by ICE, and her death has sparked protests and marches in several parts of the city, as well as backlash from Democrats. In a separate incident, two people were shot and wounded by ICE agents in Portland, Oregon

incidents.title: Canadian Prime Minister Will Visit China on Jan 13
incidents.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney will visit China on Jan 13 as Canada seeks to diversify away from the United States. This comes as China is also looking at possibly purchasing some of Canada’s oil exports in light of losing access to Venezuela's.

incidents.title: Irish Prime Minister Meets with Chinese President to Increase Trade and Cooperation
incidents.description: Irish Prime Minister Micheál Martin met with Xi, and both sides signaled a willingness to increase trade and cooperation in multiple fields ahead of Ireland’s ascension to the rotating presidency of the Council of the EU later this year.

incidents.title: Denmark and Greenland Are Requesting a Meeting with the US Secretary of State Over Refusal to Rule Out Using Military Force to Take Over Greenland
incidents.description: Denmark and Greenland have requested a meeting with the U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio after the U.S. refused to rule out using military force to take over Greenland. European allies have issued a joint statement in support of Denmark and Greenland, while the Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen stated that a U.S. takeover of the island would result in the end of the NATO alliance.

incidents.title: China Launches Cyberattacks and Disinformation Posts During Taiwan Military Drills
incidents.description: Taiwan’s National Security Bureau reported that during China’s “Justice Mission 2025” military drills around Taiwan last week, Beijing launched over 4 million cyberattacks and 19,000 disinformation posts to supplement its military deployments.

incidents.title: Ukrainian President Voices Confidence for Peace Deal and End to War
incidents.description: Following peace negotiations with allies in Paris on Jan. 7, Zelenskyy said the deal is “90% ready” and expressed optimism that the war could end in the first half of this year. Details over the future control of Donbas and Zaporizhzhia are still under negotiation between Ukraine and its allies.

incidents.title: US Backs Security Guarantees At Allied Summit in Paris
incidents.description: The U.S. backed proposed security guarantees during a Jan. 6-7 allied summit in Paris. While details of the guarantees have not been made public, U.S. Special Envoy Steve Witkoff and Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner publicly advocated for the deal. On Jan. 8, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the summit produced “concrete results” and that he is seeking another in-person meeting with Trump.

incidents.title: US President Announces Agreement with Venezuela to Recieve More Barrels of Oil to Resell
incidents.description: Trump announced that he had reached an agreement with Venezuela that would see Caracas hand over 30 million to 50 million barrels of crude oil, which would allow the U.S. to sell up to $3 billion on the global oil market. While global oil prices fell by 1% on the news, oil company executives have warned that they require “serious guarantees” from the U.S. before committing to investing in Venezuela, despite assurances by Trump that the U.S. would reimburse them.

incidents.title: China and South Korea Agree to Engage in Outreach to North Korea
incidents.description: Lee met with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Beijing, where both sides agreed to engage in peaceful outreach to North Korea while also signing cooperation agreements between companies and pledging enhanced cultural exchanges.

incidents.title: Israeli Government Opens the Process to Construct the E1 Settlements in the West Bank
incidents.description: The Israeli government opened the process for developers on the construction of E1 settlements in the West Bank. Completion of the E1 settlement project would sever East Jerusalem from the remainder of the West Bank.

incidents.title: IDF Carries out Airstrikes in Southern Lebanon
incidents.description: The IDF carried out numerous airstrikes in southern Lebanon. According to the IDF, the attacks targeted Hezbollah personnel in addition to arms storage sites belonging to both Hezbollah and Hamas.

incidents.title: Israel and Syria Form a "Joint Fusion Mechanism"
incidents.description: Israel and Syria agreed to form a “joint fusion mechanism” focused primarily on de-escalation and diplomatic issues, during direct talks mediated by the U.S. An unnamed senior Syrian official cited by Israeli media said Damascus is prepared to offer Israel security guarantees, upon condition that Israeli forces withdraw from the Syrian territory they currently occupy.

incidents.title: Ukraine, France, and the UK Sign Declaration of Intent
incidents.description: The leaders of Ukraine, France, and the U.K. signed a declaration of intent to provide a postwar multinational security force in Ukraine. In response, the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs said any such troops would be considered “legitimate combat targets.”

incidents.title: 45,000 Households and 2,000 Business Left Without Power After Arson Attack by Far-Left Group
incidents.description: Around 45,000 households and 2,000 businesses were left without power following a suspected arson attack by the far-left Vulkangruppe in protest of the “fossil-fuel economy.” The attack caused the longest blackout in Germany since World War II and has highlighted the country’s vulnerability to sabotage attacks.

incidents.title: President Trump Threatens Military Interevention Against Iran
incidents.description: Trump threatened military intervention against Iran in response to the Iranian government's violent crackdown on mass protests.

incidents.title: Taiwanese Legislator Suggests Antagonistic Renaming of Act
incidents.description: A Taiwanese legislator from the ruling Democratic Progressive Party suggested that the “Act Governing Relations Between the People of the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area” should be renamed to the “Taiwan and the People’s Republic of China (PRC) Relations Act.” While unlikely to formally be enacted, Beijing warned that such a change would heighten the risk of war.

incidents.title: Russia Captures Hrabovske Village in Ukraine's Sumy Region
incidents.description: Russia claimed to have captured Hrabovske village in Ukraine’s Sumy region. Kyiv has previously accused Russian forces of forcibly deporting Hrabovske residents into Russian territory

incidents.title: North Korea Launches Several Ballistic Missiles Off East Coast
incidents.description: North Korea launched several ballistic missiles off its East Coast on the same day as the South Korean President Lee Jae Myung’s state visit to Beijing.

incidents.title: US Commander of Forces Korea Announces Broadened Scope to Include Taiwan Contingency
incidents.description: The commander of United States Forces Korea, Gen. Xavier T. Brunson, stated that the scope of his forces has now widened to formally include a response to a potential Taiwan contingency.

incidents.title: US Military Conducted a Raid in Venezuela and Captured President Maduro and His Wife
incidents.description: The U.S. military conducted a raid on Venezuela’s Fort Tiuna military base, capturing and extracting President Nicolas Maduro and his wife, while close air support targeted multiple sites around Caracas, resulting in around 75 casualties. Maduro and his wife pleaded not guilty to the charges of using his position of power to smuggle cocaine into the United States. They were brought before a court in New York, while former Vice President Delcy Rodriguez has been appointed as interim leader of the country, following assertions by the Trump administration that the U.S. would run Venezuela until a just transition can take place. Trump warned of possibly taking similar actions against Colombia, Cuba, Mexico, and Greenland.

incidents.title: Trump Confirms CIA Drone Strike on Venezuelan Port as Tensions Escalate
incidents.description: Trump confirmed that the CIA had conducted a drone strike against a Venezuelan port, marking the first instance of land-based strike by the U.S. since tensions between the countries began to escalate. Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro has not commented on the strike, though he reiterated his openness to talks with the U.S. about drug trafficking.

incidents.title: Finland Seizes Russian Cargo Ship Over Suspected Undersea Cable Sabotage
incidents.description: Finnish security personnel seized a Russian cargo vessel and detained its crew, who had been accused of damaging undersea cables in the Gulf of Finland. The vessel had been traveling from St. Petersburg to Haifa, Israel.

incidents.title: Trump Threatens Military Action Over Iran Protests as Tehran Warns of Regional Chaos
incidents.description: As deadly anti-government protests in Iran continue, Trump threatened U.S. military intervention if peaceful protesters were killed, saying, “We are locked and loaded and ready to go.” In response Iran’s Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council Ali Larijani said U.S. intervention would lead to regional chaos and accused the U.S. and Israel of stoking the protests.
